title: Cleared direct-source TimeSample can be replayed to restore wall-clock validity
description: Timing correctness review: clear removes the current sample but establishes no issuance or adoption barrier for direct providers. Stale or duplicate checks run only while a current sample exists, and replay high-water exists only for network evidence. The exact previously adopted direct TimeSample can be submitted after clear and accepted again. Add one-use provider issuance or per-authority adoption and invalidation high-water semantics so pre-clear and previously accepted samples cannot re-establish time while a newly issued post-clear sample can.
notes: Security extension: define one-use semantics for all issued samples, not only successful direct-source adoptions. A network sample rejected before high-water advancement or a direct sample issued before clear/policy change can currently be resubmitted later while fresh. Decide and specify whether consideration consumes issuance; recovery after expiry should require a newly issued sample if replay rejection is normative.
